assignments.briefing: Liberate Seasse to protect the Ministry of Science expeditionary teams as they trigger the total collapse of the Void.
assignments.title: MAJOR ORDER

dispatches.message: EXOSTORM ADVISORY A Category 3 Exostorm has been detected on KARLIA, blanketing the planet in violent celestial super-storms. These unnatural atmospheric anomalies threaten to disrupt our current operations. High Command demands absolute operational resilience in the face of these severe environmental hazards. Helldivers: defend KARLIA to nullify the Exostorm before it can worsen. Do not let these celestial tempests halt our advance.

EXOSTORM ADVISORY A Category 3 Exostorm has been detected on ALARAPH, blanketing the planet in violent celestial super-storms. These unnatural atmospheric anomalies threaten to disrupt our current operations. High Command demands absolute operational resilience in the face of these severe environmental hazards. Helldivers: defend ALARAPH to nullify the Exostorm before it can worsen. Do not let these celestial tempests halt our advance.

DSS STATUS UPDATE The DSS (Democracy Space Station) is undergoing examination after exiting the Void. Reports of rhythmic knocking across the hull have been independently confirmed, and though they have intensified, High Command maintains these vibrations are merely localized thermal contraction. The examiners assigned by the Ministry of Truth have volunteered to remain aboard indefinitely to monitor the situation; as a precaution, all outbound shuttle access is suspended.

EXOSTORM ADVISORY A Category 3 Exostorm has been detected on ALAIRT III, blanketing the planet in violent celestial super-storms. These unnatural atmospheric anomalies threaten to disrupt our current operations. High Command demands absolute operational resilience in the face of these severe environmental hazards. Helldivers: defend ALAIRT III to nullify the Exostorm before it can worsen. Do not let these celestial tempests halt our advance.

SEASSE SCIENCE EXPEDITION SITREP The elite 18-person research team has reached the secondary lithospheric layer of Seasse. Sub-surface telemetry remains highly encouraging. The team has voluntarily deactivated their atmospheric filtration masks to better sample the localized, ecosystem through their own sense of Democracy. Progress remains entirely on schedule.

SEASSE SCIENCE EXPEDITION SITREP The elite 20-person Ministry of Science team has successfully breached the crust of Seasse. Their objective: to map the subterranean geological geometry and initiate the completely understood dissolution of the Void from its physical core. High Command reports optimal morale as these brave Patriots begin their descent into the anomaly.

NEW MAJOR ORDER The Helldivers have reached the heart of the Void: Seasse, and must liberate the planet by any means necessary to stop the spread of this breeding ground for Tyranny. While forces clear the surface, an elite 20-person Ministry of Science team will descend into its depths to collapse the Void from within. High Command guarantees this process is entirely safe and completely understood.

FINAL PREPARATIONS: SEASSE The Void Warp Relay calibration is complete. Helldivers are advised: T-Minus 1 Hour to Landfall. The path to to Seasse, the Void source planet, is fully stabilized. All Helldivers are ordered to conclude preparatory operations. Ready for imminent deployment into the heart of the anomaly, and the lawful eradication of the Void. For Super Earth.

T-MINUS 3 HOURS: SEASSE Final systems checks are underway across the vanguard fleet. The Void Warp Relay is approaching the terminal energy density required for transit on schedule. High Command reminds all personnel to report to battle stations and immediately report any unapproved physical mutations. Continue to prepare for imminent, synchronized FTL transit.

T-MINUS 6 HOURS: SEASSE The Void Warp Relay has entered its final power-up sequence. The jump corridor to the Void source planet will open in exactly six hours. Logistics teams will soon finalize the distribution of advanced arsenal augmentations across all participating destroyer hulls. Ensure all standard-issue compliance tools are fully serviced.

T-MINUS 7 HOURS: SEASSE The Void Warp Relay is nearing optimal calibration. The jump to Seasse, the Void source planet will commence in 7 hours. Tactical augmentations procured by the Helldivers during this preparatory phase are currently being processed by fleet logistics. The Illuminate will soon face the inescapable reality of Managed Democracy.

VOID PLANET TRIANGULATED UVP DELTA is now reachable, thanks to Helldiver efforts. All detected planet within the Void are now accessible, with the exception of one, which is believed to lie at the Void's astro-temporal center.

MAJOR ORDER WON The Helldivers’ investigative charting of the Void's initial layer was a masterclass in conquering the unknown. Data extracted from the three initial worlds allowed SEAF navigation arrays to successfully calibrate despite the unlawful spacetime anomalies, narrowing search parameters for the hidden Illuminate source planet. As such, the offensive toward the enemy's central base of operations remains on schedule, and with immediate SEAF support available.
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION To aid their valiant efforts, all Helldiver deployments on UVP ALPHA will be augmented with the Shield Generator Pack Stratagem for the next 24 hours.

SEASSE LOCATED The body at the Void barycenter closely matches known properties of the planet Seasse, the first to fall into the Void. This confirms theories on approaching the Void's origin. Nearly enough data has been gathered to allow travel to Seasse. The Helldivers are ordered to take all necessary measures to hasten the final stages of research.

VOID PLANET TRIANGULATED Coordinates for HYDROBIUS have been determined within .01% error, following extensive Void material analysis. Operations on the planet may now commence. Matter from planets within the Void has been discovered to posses varying levels of a novel property similar in principle to radiation. Higher levels of radiation are believed to indicate longer exposure to the Void, and thus point towards the Void's origin.

VOID PLANET TRIANGULATED Helldiver actions within the Void have enabled the triangulation of UVP BETA, which may now be accessed. The Helldivers are ordered to support further data gathering efforts in order to support continued progress toward's the Void's center.

DSS STATUS UPDATE The gloom-resistant polymer coating enabling the DSS to sustain the corrosive spore environment is having an adverse reaction to the warp relay treatment. Rumors of taps or knocks on the hull of the station are unfounded. The DSS is exiting the void for examination.

STRATEGIC ADVISORY Data indicates the exteriors of the Void is barricaded with highly intense cosmic radiation field. In order to avoid molecular disintegration, or worse, Helldivers are advised to utilize the Warp Relay on the gateway planet of RIRGA BAY to enter the Void. This is a perfectly safe and mandatory process for destroyer and crew.

INTELLIGENCE BRIEF Intel confirms deployment of two new Illuminate biological weapons. The Wretch is a feral skirmisher. Sever its bladed appendages; cranial trauma has no effect. The Crusher absorbs ballistics via unpatriotic tissue regeneration. Concentrate fire on its control helmet to expose a lethal vulnerability. Attempting to reason with these mutations is both highly treasonous and instantly fatal. Righteous eradication is a mandated act of mercy.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Helldivers are to enter the Void immediately. Here, conventional navigational arrays are non-functional. To aid the science teams deploying alongside ground forces and enable onward navigation to the hidden Void source planet, Helldivers must extract 35,000,000 samples from UVP ALPHA, complete 1,000,000 operations on UVP GAMMA, and eliminate 1,250,000,000 hostiles on SENGE 23.

MAJOR ORDER WON The Helldivers successfully protected Rirga Bay, proving that no amount of Illuminate genetic tampering can withstand Liberty's might. Consequently, the Void Warp Relay has achieved full operational status. In addition to securing primary fuel metrics, the enthusiastic harvesting of E-711 enabled High Command to reward auxiliary SEAF regiments with immediate, mandatory deployment into the Void alongside Super Earth's most elite forces.

FORCE AUGMENTATION High Command has authorized auxiliary SEAF infantry to deploy alongside Helldivers on Rirga Bay. SEAF detachments will deploy to ongoing Helldiver missions as available to augment firepower and draw enemy aggression. SEAF troops report ecstatic morale at this opportunity to witness Helldiver lethality firsthand.

NEW MAJOR ORDER To breach the Void, engineering corps are finalizing a Void Warp Relay on Rirga Bay. However, initial calibration tests have allowed an onslaught of horrific Illuminate creations to spill out from the gateway, threatening construction. Helldivers must hold Rirga Bay, stop the spread of these grotesque mutations, and collect critical E-711 to fuel the relay and facilitate upcoming SEAF deployments into the unknown.

INTELLIGENCE BRIEF In a desperate bid to halt our progress on Rirga Bay, the enemy has launched an offensive from the Void, deploying grotesque, previously unseen biological weapons designated as Vote Snatchers. These Democratically-voided thralls are highly dangerous and possess zero perceivable humanity. Helldivers must neutralize them immediately to secure the Warp Relay perimeter.
Campaign Won The TCS+ is complete. On an unbroken line of planets, Termicide 2.0 fills the atmosphere, completely preventing the possibility of Terminid infestation.

MINOR TERMINID OUTBREAK A minor Terminid outbreak has occured on CRIMSICA. It is evident that some dissidents continue their hopeless effort to disrupt citizen confidence in the TCS+. The Helldivers are ordered to put down this small, low-threat outbreak.

MINOR TERMINID OUTBREAK A minor Terminid outbreak has occured on FORI PRIME. It is evident that some dissidents continue their hopeless effort to disrupt citizen confidence in the TCS+. The Helldivers are ordered to put down this small, low-threat outbreak.

STRATEGIC IMPERATIVE SEIZED The Helldivers have liberated stolen materials from Cyborg Megafactories, which are en route to the Warp Relay Station under construciton on RIRGA BAY. These materials will be repurposed from the perpetuation of socialist terrorism to the pursuit of science.

NEW STRATEGIC IMPERATIVE Engineers on RIRGA BAY have found a way to penetrate the Void. Alcubiere warp bubbles can be modified to provid insulation from the cosmic radiation field at the Void's barrier. This has been demonstrated in a laboratory setting using various amphibians. Construction of a Warp Relay Station, to transport Destroyers, has already begun on RIRGA BAY. The Helldivers are ordered to aid construction by liberating materials from Cyborg Megafactories.

news.translated:
EXOSTORM ADVISORY

在可利亚探测到一场3级外风暴，在猛烈的天体超级风暴中覆盖了地球。

这些不自然的大气异常有可能扰乱我们目前的行动。面对这些严重的环境危害，最高指挥部要求绝对的作战弹性。

绝地潜兵：保卫可利亚，在外风暴恶化之前使其无效。

不要让这些天风暴阻止我们前进。

DSS状态更新

DSS（民主空间站）在离开寂域后正在接受检查。船体上有节奏的敲击声的报道已得到独立证实，尽管它们已经加剧，但最高指挥部坚称这些振动只是局部的热收缩。

真相部指派的审查员自愿无限期留在船上监督情况；作为预防措施，所有出站班车通道暂停。

西斯科学考察团

精英18人研究团队已抵达西斯次级岩石圈层。地下遥测技术仍然非常令人鼓舞。

该团队自愿停用了他们的大气过滤口罩，以便通过他们自己的民主意识更好地对当地的生态系统进行采样。进展完全按计划进行。

西斯科学考察团

科学部20人的精英团队成功突破西斯地壳。他们的目标：绘制地下地质几何图，并从其物理核心开始完全理解寂域的溶解。

最高指挥部报告称，当这些勇敢的爱国者开始陷入异常状态时，士气最佳。

新重要指令

绝地潜兵已经到达寂域的中心：西斯，必须通过任何必要的手段解放这个星球，以阻止这个暴政滋生地的扩散。

当力量清除表面时，一支20人的科学部精英团队将深入其深处，从内部摧毁寂域。最高指挥部保证这一过程是完全安全和完全理解的。

最终准备：西斯

通往寂域源行星西斯的道路已经完全稳定。所有绝地潜兵被命令完成准备行动。准备立即部署到异常的中心，合法铲除寂域。

超级地球。

major_order.title: MAJOR ORDER
major_order.brief: Liberate Seasse to protect the Ministry of Science expeditionary teams as they trigger the total collapse of the Void.
major_order.translated_brief: 解放西斯以保护科学部远征队，因为他们触发了寂域的全面崩溃。
